title: FRED G10 Carry Trade Signal
description: G10 carry-trade pair scanner for the FX & Rate-Differential Brief. Pulls short-term policy rates for the G10 currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD, NZD, CHF, NOK, SEK) plus their 10Y sovereign yields, then computes ALL pairwise rate differentials (45 pairs). Each pair row reports the funder currency, target currency, short-rate spread, 10Y spread, classic-carry-trade-attractive flag, and a recommended ETF expression (long target FX ETF + short funder FX ETF). Carry-trade entries flagged when short-rate spread >= 2.0% AND 10Y spread is positive (not signalling immediate easing). Uses existing FRED_API_KEY.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
now_epoch = int(now.timestamp())

API_KEY = CREDENTIALS.get('FRED_API_KEY', '')
BASE = 'https://api.stlouisfed.org/fred/series/observations'

EXPECTED_COLUMNS = [
    'pair_code', 'funder_currency', 'target_currency',
    'funder_short_rate', 'target_short_rate', 'short_rate_spread',
    'funder_10y_yield', 'target_10y_yield', 'long_yield_spread',
    'carry_attractive', 'curve_supports_carry',
    'investment_thesis', 'etf_expression', '_epoch',
]

# Policy / short rate proxies - using 3-month rates where harmonised series
# is available, falling back to policy rates. Coverage skips currencies
# with thin / unreliable FRED coverage.
SHORT_RATE_SERIES = {
    'USD': 'FEDFUNDS',
    'EUR': 'ECBDFR',
    'JPY': 'IRSTCI01JPM156N',
    'GBP': 'IR3TIB01GBM156N',
    'CAD': 'IR3TIB01CAM156N',
    'AUD': 'IR3TIB01AUM156N',
    'CHF': 'IR3TIB01CHM156N',
    'NZD': 'IR3TIB01NZM156N',
}

LONG_YIELD_SERIES = {
    'USD': 'DGS10',
    'EUR': 'IRLTLT01DEM156N',
    'JPY': 'IRLTLT01JPM156N',
    'GBP': 'IRLTLT01GBM156N',
    'CAD': 'IRLTLT01CAM156N',
    'AUD': 'IRLTLT01AUM156N',
    'CHF': 'IRLTLT01CHM156N',
    'NZD': 'IRLTLT01NZM156N',
}

ETF_LONG = {
    'USD': 'UUP', 'EUR': 'FXE', 'JPY': 'FXY', 'GBP': 'FXB',
    'CAD': 'FXC', 'AUD': 'FXA', 'CHF': 'FXF', 'NZD': 'BNZ',
}

def fetch_latest(series_id):
    if not series_id:
        return None
    try:
        resp = requests.get(
            BASE,
            params={
                'series_id': series_id,
                'api_key': API_KEY,
                'file_type': 'json',
                'sort_order': 'desc',
                'limit': 5,
            },
            timeout=30,
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        payload = resp.json() or {}
        obs = payload.get('observations', []) or []
    except Exception:
        return None
    for oi in range(len(obs)):
        o = obs[oi]
        if not isinstance(o, dict):
            continue
        v = o.get('value', '.')
        if v == '.' or v is None:
            continue
        try:
            return float(v)
        except Exception:
            continue
    return None

short_rates = {}
long_yields = {}
currencies = sorted(SHORT_RATE_SERIES.keys())
for ci in range(len(currencies)):
    ccy = currencies[ci]
    sr = fetch_latest(SHORT_RATE_SERIES.get(ccy, ''))
    ly = fetch_latest(LONG_YIELD_SERIES.get(ccy, ''))
    if sr is not None:
        short_rates[ccy] = sr
    if ly is not None:
        long_yields[ccy] = ly

def thesis_for(funder, target, spread, curve_ok, etf_long_target, etf_long_funder):
    if spread >= 2.0 and curve_ok:
        return 'High-conviction carry: long ' + target + ' vs short ' + funder + ' - long ' + etf_long_target + ', short ' + etf_long_funder + '. Watch for risk-off unwinds.'
    if spread >= 1.0 and curve_ok:
        return 'Modest carry available: long ' + target + ' vs short ' + funder + '; size small or use options to limit drawdown'
    if spread >= 0.5:
        return 'Marginal rate spread; only attractive if FX trend reinforces - wait for confirmation'
    if spread <= -2.0:
        return 'Reverse carry: borrow in ' + target + ' (lower rate); fade with long ' + etf_long_funder + ' / short ' + etf_long_target
    return 'No edge - pair near rate parity'

rows = []
for i in range(len(currencies)):
    funder = currencies[i]
    if funder not in short_rates:
        continue
    funder_sr = short_rates[funder]
    funder_ly = long_yields.get(funder)
    for j in range(len(currencies)):
        if i == j:
            continue
        target = currencies[j]
        if target not in short_rates:
            continue
        target_sr = short_rates[target]
        target_ly = long_yields.get(target)
        spread = round(target_sr - funder_sr, 3)
        long_spread = None
        curve_ok = False
        if funder_ly is not None and target_ly is not None:
            long_spread = round(target_ly - funder_ly, 3)
            curve_ok = long_spread > 0
        carry_attractive = spread >= 1.5 and curve_ok
        etf_long_t = ETF_LONG.get(target, '')
        etf_long_f = ETF_LONG.get(funder, '')
        etf_expr = 'long ' + etf_long_t + ' / short ' + etf_long_f if etf_long_t and etf_long_f else ''
        thesis = thesis_for(funder, target, spread, curve_ok, etf_long_t, etf_long_f)
        pair_code = target + funder
        rows.append({
            'pair_code': pair_code,
            'funder_currency': funder,
            'target_currency': target,
            'funder_short_rate': round(funder_sr, 3),
            'target_short_rate': round(target_sr, 3),
            'short_rate_spread': spread,
            'funder_10y_yield': round(funder_ly, 3) if funder_ly is not None else None,
            'target_10y_yield': round(target_ly, 3) if target_ly is not None else None,
            'long_yield_spread': long_spread,
            'carry_attractive': carry_attractive,
            'curve_supports_carry': curve_ok,
            'investment_thesis': thesis,
            'etf_expression': etf_expr,
            '_epoch': now_epoch,
        })

if rows:
    df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)
    df = df.sort_values(['carry_attractive', 'short_rate_spread'], ascending=[False, False]).reset_index(drop=True)
else:
    df = pd.DataFrame(columns=EXPECTED_COLUMNS)

GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
